title: 群核科技黄晓煌：AI虚拟拍摄取代物理场地，电影制作效率能提升多少？
speaker: Victor Huang

segments.en: We worked with many customers and partners like Hosea, we used their data to collect more data in our space for training.
segments.zh: 我们与许多客户和合作伙伴合作，比如Hosea，利用他们的数据在我们的空间中收集更多数据用于训练。

segments.en: And we also have a lot of customers like the Hyundai and they use our technology to help the modern filmmaker who before they properly need to use the physical place for virtual filming.
segments.zh: 我们还有很多客户，比如现代，他们利用我们的技术帮助现代电影制作人，以前他们可能需要使用物理场地进行虚拟拍摄。

segments.en: And now they can scan the whole place that put it on virtual world and they can generate the film much easier than before.
segments.zh: 现在他们可以扫描整个场地，将其放入虚拟世界，比以前更容易地生成电影。
